Method of Attack: Two stack-based buffer overflows allowing remote code execution without authentication
Authentication bypass and remote code execution flaws
Impacted Systems: Ivanti Avalanche enterprise mobility management (EMM) solution
Attack Vector: Remotely exploitable via specially crafted data packets over TCP port 1777
Indicators of Compromise: TCP port 1777, hex strings (type 3) or list of decimal strings separated by ';' (type 9) in data packets
